facts.value: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical environments.

Architecture involves how people move through space, how light enters a room, how a building meets the ground, how a wall assembly holds up, how a plan supports daily life, and how a structure fits a climate, budget, and culture.
Architecture is broader than decoration and broader than construction alone.
A beginner mistake is treating architecture like a clean drawing problem; it is not.
Architecture is a coordination problem where structure, materials, weather, circulation, code, cost, and human use all push back at the same time.
The complexity of architecture is what makes it worth studying as it requires both technical constraints and imagination from the first sketch onward.
